json-merge-patch.name: JSON Merge Patch
json-merge-patch.description: Apply RFC 7396 patches to JSON configurations: merge objects, remove fields and replace arrays locally.

meta.title: JSON Merge Patch
meta.description: Apply RFC 7396 patches to JSON configurations: merge objects, remove fields and replace arrays locally.
meta.keywords: JSON merge patch, RFC 7396, merge JSON, configuration patch

jsonMergePatch.emptyResult: Enter a target and a merge patch, then apply to see the result.
jsonMergePatch.hint: Each input accepts {characters} UTF-16 code units and {depth} nesting levels. Use strict JSON without duplicate object keys. Large numbers retain their precision.
jsonMergePatch.rules: RFC 7396: objects merge recursively; arrays and scalar patches replace the entire target value. An object patch applied to a non-object starts from an empty object. Formatting is normalized.
jsonMergePatch.nullRule: A null object member deletes that field; it cannot set a field to null. A null patch at the root replaces the entire document with null. This tool applies merge patches, not JSON Patch operation arrays (RFC 6902).
jsonMergePatch.invalid: Invalid JSON. Check syntax and remove duplicate object keys.
jsonMergePatch.tooLarge: Use at most {characters} UTF-16 code units per input.
jsonMergePatch.outputLimit: The formatted result exceeds {limit} UTF-16 code units. Reduce the input size.
